class_id: a per-document record that covers only some of the tables the document writes
feature: any write path that records 'which source produced which value' (a receipt, a lineage tag) beside the values it writes, where the values go to several tables but the record is built from only some of them
symptom: the record is the only way to ask 'what did THIS source give us', so every value written outside the recorded tables becomes invisible to that question: the source looks almost empty while its values sit in the database unattributed. Checks, supersession and audits that read the record then treat those values as never delivered. Universal shape: the record is built from the same variables as the first writes in the function, and later writes (child tables, side writers) were added without adding to the record.
